response.query: What sample-size targets and effect-size scenarios (with power calculations) should we pre-register per pilot condition to support mixed-effects analysis and avoid post hoc selection?
response.answer: For mixed-effects analysis, pre-register sample sizes based on desired power (typically 80%) and expected effect size; commonly, G*Power or similar tools are used for precise calculations. Aim for at least 30-50 observations per condition to avoid post hoc selection bias.
